channel.title: Samira Home Decor — Home Décor, Lifestyle & Fragrance
channel.description: Curated pieces for elevated living. Shipped Australia-wide.

item.g:title: Aurelia Marble & Gold Bathroom Set (5-Piece)
item.g:description: Turn a daily routine into a five-star ritual. The Aurelia set brings hand-glazed marble ceramic and hand-painted gold veining to your basin, each piece finished with a gilded base that catches the light. A complete five-piece collection that makes even the smallest bathroom feel like a boutique hotel, choose classic white, deep emerald green or midnight black, all pooled with liquid-gold marbling.

item.g:title: Dark Marble Bathroom Set (4-Piece)
item.g:description: Cut from solid Emperador Dark marble, this is the set that makes a bathroom feel like a hotel suite. The stone is a deep espresso brown shot through with pale gold and cream veining, and because every block is quarried rather than moulded, no two pieces in your set will ever match exactly. Weighty in the hand, cool to the touch, and finished with a polished gold pump. Four pieces that sit beautifully together on a vanity, or apart across the tray by the bath, the dispenser at the basin.

item.g:title: Lumière Crystal Bathroom Vanity Set — 4 Piece
item.g:description: Bring a boutique-hotel feel to your bathroom with the Lumière vanity set, cut from heavy, high-clarity crystal glass that catches the light from every angle. A bevelled crystal tray anchors a square lotion pump, a lidded cotton bud jar and your choice of a faceted diffuser ball or a slatted soap dish, keeping your basin tidy while looking like a styled display. Choose smoke grey for a moody, modern finish, iridescent clear for a soft rainbow shimmer, or amber gold for warmth and glamour. A beautiful upgrade for your own vanity and a gift that feels truly special.

item.g:title: Trio Wall-Mounted Shower Dispenser — 3 in 1
item.g:description: Clear the clutter from your shower ledge with this three-chamber dispenser that keeps shampoo, conditioner and body wash neatly in one place. It mounts straight onto tiles, glass or smooth walls with a strong adhesive backing, so there's no drilling and no damage, which makes it ideal for rentals. Each chamber has its own easy-press button that releases just the right amount, and the tinted windows let you see when it's time for a refill. A tidy, hotel-style upgrade for family bathrooms, guest rooms and Airbnb stays.

item.g:title: Aura Mist Ultrasonic Diffuser 160ml
item.g:description: A sculptural teardrop diffuser that turns fragrance into a moment. Whisper-quiet ultrasonic mist, soft ambient light and a 160ml reservoir bring calm, scent and a designer silhouette to any room.

item.g:title: Flame-Effect Ultrasonic Humidifier & Diffuser
item.g:description: Set the mood with the gentle flicker of a flame, without the flame. A 3-in-1 essential-oil diffuser, air humidifier and flame-effect night light in one 200ml unit, it projects a remarkably realistic dancing flame while releasing a fine, whisper-quiet mist (as low as 40 decibels) that softens dry air and carries your favourite oils through the room. A calming centrepiece for the living room, bedroom, office, yoga studio or gym, with 1/3/5-hour timers and an auto shut-off when the water runs low. Add a few drops of oil, dim the lights, and unwind.

item.g:title: Ondine Abstract Curve Cushion Covers — Set of 2 (45cm)
item.g:description: Add instant texture and warmth to your sofa or bed with this pair of 45cm cushion covers. Soft, raised loops are tufted into flowing abstract curves across a creamy textured base, giving each cover a hand-crafted, wabi-sabi feel that looks beautiful up close. Choose from six earthy tones, from bold rust and rich brown to soft beige and calming grey, and pair them with neutrals for an effortless, layered look. Sold as covers only, so you can refresh your space season after season using inserts you already own.

item.g:title: Alban Bouclé Pillow Cover
item.g:description: Wrap your space in texture. The Alban cushion cover is crafted from a deep, curly bouclé with a soft, teddy-like pile that instantly adds warmth and understated luxury to sofas, beds, benches and reading nooks. In a considered palette of seven rich tones, from berry red to sage, soft blush and espresso, it layers effortlessly with linen, wool and neutrals to refresh a room in seconds. A concealed zip keeps the finish clean and makes seasonal swaps easy, and because it's sold as a cover only (insert not included), you can restyle again and again without the bulk.

item.g:title: Fleur Sculptural Glass Vase
item.g:description: The Fleur glass vase brings sculptural charm to any room with a wavy silhouette that resembles an open flower. This visual statement piece is a work of art and enhances any floral arrangement you choose. Made from glass and designed for tabletop display, it suits both real and everlasting flowers. Place it on a dining table, bedside table, coffee table or kitchen bench to create an effortless centrepiece, or let it stand alone to add sculptural interest to a living space and brighten your home.

item.g:title: Ceramic Electric Oil Vaporiser
item.g:description: Bring a subtle, calming fragrance to any room with this ceramic electric oil vaporiser that gently warms essential oils without harming them. Designed to run safely for long periods, it emits heat only from the recessed bowl, so the outer surface stays cool to the touch. No water is needed, making it a drip-free option ideal for aromatherapy at night or when hosting friends, creating a calm, fragrant atmosphere in living areas, bedrooms and for quiet evenings.

item.g:title: Diamond Velvet Throw Pillow Cover
item.g:description: Add instant warmth and texture to any sofa, bed or reading nook with this diamond-quilted velvet cushion cover. Irresistibly soft with a subtle sheen and a plush, tactile finish, it layers beautifully with linen, knits and neutrals, and comes in a curated palette of eight rich colours to suit any space. Choose your size and shade, and style your own way.

item.g:title: Soft Cotton Face Washer Towels, 10 Pack (450GSM)
item.g:description: Wrap your everyday routine in softness with this set of 10 premium 450GSM cotton face washers. Beautifully plush yet quick-drying, with a satin-finish border and double-stitched hems that hold their shape wash after wash. Gentle on skin and endlessly useful for face, hands and travel, in a rich palette of eleven colours to suit any bathroom.

item.g:title: Oval Marble-Effect Coffee Table
item.g:description: A sculptural centrepiece for the living room, this oval coffee table pairs a smooth marble-effect top with a warm, angular timber-look base. The soft oval silhouette keeps the room feeling open, while the crossed legs add architectural interest, a timeless, mid-century-inspired piece that anchors a lounge with quiet luxury. Style it with a stack of design books, a low vase or a scented candle to complete the look.

item.g:title: Marble-Look Glass Table Set, 2 Piece (80cm)
item.g:description: A refined two-piece table set that brings a soft, luxe finish to any living space. Each table is topped with marble-look tempered glass, tough enough for everyday use yet elegant enough to feel like a designer piece. Nest them together for a compact footprint, or set them apart as a coffee table and matching side table. With clean lines and neutral marble tones, they layer effortlessly with sofas, rugs and accent chairs, an easy way to elevate a lounge, bedroom or reading corner.

item.g:title: Modern Coffee Table with Storage Drawer & Open Shelf
item.g:description: Style and storage in one considered piece. This modern coffee table pairs a sleek marble-look top with a smart two-tone body, a soft-close drawer keeps remotes, chargers and clutter neatly out of sight, while the open shelf is ideal for books, baskets or a styling tray. Raised on slender metal legs, it feels light and contemporary, the perfect centrepiece for a living room that likes to stay tidy and effortlessly put-together.

item.g:title: Ergolux Plus Ergonomic Mesh Office Chair with Footrest (Grey)
item.g:description: Work, study or game in all-day comfort with the Ergolux Plus ergonomic mesh office chair. The breathable mesh back keeps you cool through the longest sessions, while adaptive lumbar support, an adjustable headrest and 3D armrests shape the chair around you. Recline up to 140°, put your feet up on the retractable footrest, and glide silently on quiet castor wheels. Choose the model that suits you, from the everyday Core to the fully loaded Elite, each finished in a cool, contemporary grey.

item.g:title: Food-Vendor Stand-Up Pouches, Resealable Zipper (10-Pack)
item.g:description: Food-safe, resealable stand-up pouches that keep your product fresh and looking retail-ready, ideal for coffee, granola, nuts, dried fruit, spices, lollies, protein and pet treats. The multi-layer PET + PA + PE structure blocks moisture and odour, while the zipper top opens and reseals again and again. Made with recycled materials and finished with vibrant flexo printing. Buy retail packs here, or order wholesale in bulk with your own logo and artwork, chat with us live for the rate card, samples or custom branding.

item.g:title: Amara Upholstered Bed Frame with 3 Drawers, Oat White
item.g:description: A bed that anchors the whole room. The Amara's bedhead runs extra wide and stands tall, softly padded and panelled with angled stitching that catches the light differently through the day, so the wall behind your bed stops being an afterthought. It is upholstered in a warm oat white that reads cream rather than grey, and sits on a sturdy slatted platform base, so your mattress needs no box spring underneath. Three deep drawers roll out on castors for spare linen, winter blankets and everything a bedroom quietly accumulates. Wide enough that bedside tables tuck neatly against either side, which is exactly how it is meant to be styled.

item.g:title: KitchenAid Artisan Plus Stand Mixer 4.7L, Feather Pink
item.g:description: The mixer people photograph as much as they use. Full metal construction, a 4.7 litre stainless bowl and planetary mixing that works the whole bowl rather than one side of it, so a cake batter comes together evenly and a bread dough is actually kneaded. Eleven speeds, including a half-fold speed for folding egg whites or chocolate through without knocking the air out, and a bowl light that comes on by itself when the head is lowered. The tilt head lifts clear to add flour or swap the beater. In Feather Pink, which is the reason most people choose this one over the stainless.

Available in eight colours, from moody Dark Grey and Blue-grey to soft Beige, Pink and fresh Fruit Green.

item.g:title: Rita 4 Seater Electric Recliner Sofa in Light Taupe Brown

The Rita 4 Seater Electric Recliner Sofa in Light Taupe Brown has 62cm-deep seats, which is deep enough to sit back into with your legs up rather than perching on the front edge. The left and right seats recline by button ; the middle two stay upright, so someone can sit normally beside a person who's fully stretched out. The middle module has a manual three-position headrest, and USB and USB-C ports are built in.

item.g:title: Round Walnut Coffee Table with Travertine-Look Stone Top, Low
item.g:description: A low round coffee table with a durable sintered stone top in a travertine finish, set on a walnut veneer base with vertical reeding. The rounded shape keeps a living room feeling soft and easy to move around.

item.g:title: Brown Oak Entertainment Unit with Champagne Glass Top
item.g:description: A long, low entertainment unit in brown oak veneer with rounded end panels and a champagne-toned glass top. Four handleless doors open to oak-lined cupboards with cable outlets at the back, on a recessed champagne gold base.

item.g:title: White Stone Coffee Table with Floating Glass and Bronze Legs
item.g:description: A white sintered stone coffee table with soft grey veining and a clear glass layer that floats above one side. Sculptural brushed bronze legs in open, curving shapes make it a gallery-style centrepiece.

item.g:title: Round Cream Leather Ottoman
item.g:description: A low, round ottoman in soft pebbled cream leather, with stitched seams dividing the top into four panels. Use it as a footrest, extra seat or, with a tray on top, a soft coffee table.

item.g:title: Curved Dining Table with Statuario White Stone Top, 240cm
item.g:description: A 240 x 118cm dining table with a marble-look Statuario white sintered stone top, curved edges and a gold outline. Two matte black column legs with reeded detailing give it a balanced, architectural base.

item.g:title: Sand Beige Adjustable Bar Stool with Armrest
item.g:description: A bar stool in smooth sand beige vegan leather with an open curved back, a padded armrest and a cushioned seat. The black pedestal base has a footrest and adjustable height for counter or bar use.

item.g:title: Oak Pedestal Dining Table with Champagne Glass Top, 240cm
item.g:description: A 240 x 120cm dining table that seats eight to ten. A champagne-toned glass top rests on a single rounded brown oak veneer pedestal, finished with a champagne gold collar.

item.g:title: Light Oak Dining Table, 180cm
item.g:description: A 180 x 100cm dining table in light oak veneer with softly rounded edges and broad panel legs set in from each end. It seats six to eight, with room for a chair at the head of the table.

item.g:title: Walnut Vegan Leather Dining Chair with Gold Legs
item.g:description: A dining chair wrapped in walnut brown vegan leather, with a curved backrest, angular armrests and an open back. The cushioned seat sits on four legs with brushed gold tips.

item.g:title: Brown Oak Bedside Table with Champagne Glass Top
item.g:description: A bedside table in brown oak veneer with curved side panels and a champagne-toned glass top. Two handleless drawers sit above a matching champagne gold base.

item.g:title: Cream Velvet King Bed with Winged Headboard
item.g:description: A king bed in soft cream velvet with a wing-shaped headboard and vertical tufts that meet at the centre. Sturdy slats support the mattress.

item.g:title: Large Gold Sculptural Vase
item.g:description: A large gold vase with a sculptural shape that becomes part of the arrangement, not just a holder for it.

item.g:title: Brushed Brass Open-Frame Wall Clock
item.g:description: A wall clock with a slender iron frame in a brushed brass finish, a double outer ring and black hands. The open face has no numerals, so the wall shows through.

item.g:title: Round Brushed Gold Mirror, 118cm
item.g:description: A large 118cm round mirror with a slim brushed gold aluminium frame.

item.g:title: White Stone Dresser with Walnut Base, 9 Drawers
item.g:description: A curved dresser with a white sintered stone top, nine smooth-gliding drawers and brass-tone handles on a walnut brown wooden base.

item.g:title: Mocha Walnut Bedside Table with Arch Detail
item.g:description: A walnut veneer bedside table with a carved arch on the front and two drawers. Black handles with gold-tone ends finish it.

item.g:title: Mustard Velvet Queen Bed with Curved Headboard
item.g:description: A queen bed with a bold curved headboard in rich mustard velveteen fabric, a low-profile frame and a slatted base.

item.g:title: Stone Cream Woven Fabric Queen Bed
item.g:description: A minimalist queen bed in soft, textured stone cream woven fabric on a sturdy frame.

item.g:title: Stone Cream King Single Bed with Sculptural Headboard
item.g:description: A king single bed in textured stone cream woven fabric, with a sculptural headboard and a low, rounded frame.

item.g:title: White Fabric Queen Bed with Floating Bedside Drawers
item.g:description: A queen bed in smooth white woven fabric with a low frame, curved edges and a slatted base. Two floating medium brown ash veneer drawers extend from either side of the headboard.

item.g:title: Pearl Beige Bouclé 2.5 Seater Sofa Bed
item.g:description: A sofa bed in soft pearl beige bouclé with rounded bolster arms and a deep, low seat. A fabric handle between the cushions pulls the base out into a flat bed.

item.g:title: Smoky Walnut Curved Bedside Table
item.g:description: A curved bedside table in smoky walnut veneer with ribbed sides, layered detailing and two drawers.

item.g:title: Stone White Fabric Dining Chair
item.g:description: A dining chair in soft, textured stone white fabric with a curved wrap-around backrest, a generously cushioned seat and sturdy rounded legs.

item.g:title: Amber Ash Dining Table with Reeded Triangle Bases, 240cm
item.g:description: A 240 x 120cm dining table in amber brown ash veneer that seats eight to ten. Two triangular pedestal bases with vertical reeding hold up the top.

item.g:title: Beige Woven Fabric Counter Stool
item.g:description: A compact counter stool in mid beige woven fabric with a sculpted, fully wrapped form and a slim metal footrest.

item.g:title: Ash Oak Sculptural Sideboard

item.g:title: Sand Beige Vegan Leather Dining Chair with Black Legs
item.g:description: A dining chair upholstered in sand beige vegan leather on black wooden legs.

item.g:title: Dark Ash Ridged Wooden Mirror, 140 x 110cm
item.g:description: A 140 x 110cm landscape mirror with rounded corners, framed in dark ash timber with carved parallel ridges. It suits the wall above a sideboard or dresser.

item.g:title: Beige Travertine Bookend, 14cm
item.g:description: A 14cm block of natural beige travertine with soft banding and an open-pored surface, heavy enough to keep books upright.

item.g:title: Beige Travertine Lidded Box, 17.5cm
